cards.subject: Nordrassil
lines: The first World Tree was spent stopping Archimonde at Hyjal, and the night elves' immortality went with it.
Everything in this city is an attempt to get that back.

cards.subject: The blessing that was refused
lines: The druids grew Teldrassil to win back the immortality they spent stopping Archimonde at Hyjal.
Nozdormu, whose blessing made the first World Tree's gift work, judged the request arrogant and refused it.
The tree grew anyway. The immortality never came back. This city is built on a request that was denied.

cards.subject: The youngest capital
lines: Ironforge and Stormwind are ancient. This island was grown a handful of years before you walked onto it.
Nothing was built on a site. The ground itself was made first.
Everyone you pass is older than the earth they are standing on.

cards.subject: The Warrior's Terrace
cards.tag: Look up before you go in
lines: The city gate is modelled on Namdaemun, the great gate in Seoul.
The pagoda towers come from a temple in Nara.
It is the least elf-looking thing in the city and the most specific.

cards.subject: The tree you cannot see
lines: The engine could not render a World Tree, so the second one in existence is an island with a trunk at one edge.
Metzen is on record as being disappointed by the compromise.
You live in branches nobody ever built.

cards.subject: Open to the sky
cards.tag: The buildings are set wide apart
lines: That is the design brief, in the wiki's own words, and it is why this city feels emptier than the others.
No sewers, no undercity, no roof.
Everything here is a walk, on purpose.

cards.subject: One boat
cards.tag: There is no flight master inside the walls
lines: The roost is at the foot of the tree, through the portal, in a village most people run straight past.
One dock, one boat, to Auberdine. Nothing to Stormwind.
A mage does not learn the portal here until level fifty. For most of the game, the way in is the long way.

cards.subject: Under the Cenarion Enclave
lines: The druid quarter is the most open, sky-facing district in the city.
There is a stairway down under the western bough, and the rogue trainers work in the cellar.
The one district with nothing to hide has the only basement.

seed.body: There are stairs down under the western bough of the Cenarion Enclave. Almost nobody who isn't a rogue has been down them.

cards.subject: Darnassian Protectors
lines: Every other district is garrisoned by Sentinels. This one is guarded by treants.
It is the only place in the city where the guards are the same species as the architecture.

cards.subject: Valstann Staghelm
cards.tag: Killed in front of his father
lines: A thousand years before the First War, Fandral led the night elves against the qiraji in Silithus. The qiraji worked out that his son was the weak point.
A feint drew Valstann into a trap and their general murdered him where Fandral could watch. The line broke.
The Arch Druid who later insisted on growing a new World Tree is the man that happened to.

cards.subject: Tyrande Whisperwind
lines: Malfurion is lost somewhere in the Emerald Dream. She rules the night elves by herself for the whole of this game.
She and Fandral argue openly over the direction of their people.
The Temple and the Enclave are two ends of one causeway and two sides of one argument.

cards.subject: The Temple of the Moon
cards.tag: The statue is standing in water
lines: The centrepiece is not a fountain. It is a moonwell, with the first High Priestess of the Moon standing in it.
The water is Elune's own and it is used, not looked at.
There is no palace in this city. The temple is the government as well as the faith.
